senses.gloss:
m. (-खः)
1 A letter, an epistle.
2 A god, a deity.
f. (-खा)
1 A line, a mark or row, &c.
2 Writing, hand-writing.
3 Delineation, painting.
E.
लिख to write, aff. घञ्; it is applied to the second sense, because the figures of the gods are written or delineated.

m. (-कः)
A writer, a scribe, a clerk, a copyist, &c.
E.
लिस्व to write, aff. ण्वुल्.

n. (-नं)
1 Writing, scripture.
2 The bark of the Bhoj tree, which is used for writing on in Nepal and Upper Hindustan.
3 Vomiting.
4 The leaf of the palm tree.
5 Scraping or [] cleaning the tongue.
6 Scarifying, scratching.
7 Reducing corpulency, thinning.
m. (-नः)
A sort of grass or reed, of which pens are made, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
f. (-नी)
A pen, a style.
E.
लिख to write, aff. of the act or instrument ल्युट्.

f. (-स्तिः)
Use of enemas to reduce corpulency.
E.
लेखन, and वस्ति a glyster.

m. (-कः)
1 A letter-carrier, an express, a postman.
2 One who signs a paper by proxy, who makes his mark, from inability to write, &c.
E.
लेखन writing, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be written.
n. (-यं)
An accusation or defence in law, which are required to be given in writing.
E.
लिख to write, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-भः)
INDRA.
E.
लेख a deity, and ऋषभ best.

m. (-रः)
A letter-carrier.
E.
लेख a letter, हृ to convey, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, लेखहारक, or with णिनि, लेखहारिन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Written.
E.
लिख to write, क्त aff., and the vowel changed.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
1 To be written.
2 To be scarified.
n. (-ख्यं)
1 A letter, an epistle.
2 A manuscript.
3 A drawing, a delineation.
4 A written accusation or defence.
E.
लिख to write, ख्यत् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Written, in writing, epistolary.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done in writing, contracted, executed.
E.
लेख्य, and कृत done.

f. (-का)
A brush, a pencil.
E.
लख्य a delineation, चूर्ण to pound or grind, aff. वुन् and टाप्.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A leaf or sheet of any thing for writing.
2 A written paper, a writing, a letter.
E.
लेख्य, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-कः)
The palm tree.
n. (-कं)
A leaf of the palm or any other substance used for writing on.
E.
लेख्य writing, पत्र a leaf, कन् aff.; books in the south of India, &c. being made of the leaves of the palmyra.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Written contract, record, or document.
E.
लेख्य, and प्रसङ्ग application.

n. (-नं)
An office, a counting house, &c.
E.
लेख्य writing or what is to be written, and स्थान place.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Recorded, committed to writing.
E.
लेख्य, and आरूढ mounted.
